newReleases.name: Vector Lane
newReleases.desc:
Vector Lane is a real-time puzzle game about arrows that carry numbers. Every arrow has an X and a Y component, a length and an energy, and it travels along glowing lanes on its own. You never steer the arrow. Instead you prepare the machines before it arrives: cutters, mirrors, gates, pedals, sieves, merge rings, projection rails and compression chambers.

Four distinct modes teach four ways of thinking. Split Lane cuts a vector into its components, steers each part through its own lane and fuses them back inside an orbiting ring. Projection Rail turns rails in thirty degree steps and presses arrows onto them, storing what gets removed to open energy doors later. Compression Works parks two arrows in a chamber where a pinch adds them, a spread cancels them and a twist swaps or flips the result. Vector Pipeline links everything into one production line.

Many hand built lanes with their own layouts, a detailed How to Play guide, a mechanism codex, a run archive and a vector lab for experimenting without a timer. Earn three stars per lane for clean, efficient and well timed runs. Game is calm and designed for one hand.

updates.name: Pixel Flow!
updates.seller: Loom Games Oyun Yazilim ve Pazarlama Anonim Sirketi
updates.desc:
Conveyor’s ready, pigs are on standby. Tap to send a pig onto the conveyor so it rains balls onto pixel cubes of its own color. The number above its head is its ammo: that’s how many hits it makes. Run out and it leaves the stage; if not, it slips into one of the 5 waiting slots and, when you tap again, it jumps back on the conveyor to fire another round.
The conveyor has a capacity—push past the limit and you’ll need to wait. Send them in the right order, manage the flow, and hit the cubes to clear the board piece by piece. Simple mechanic, sticky loop: tap → flow → repeat.
Highlights
One-tap control: Quick sessions, easy one-handed play.
Color matching: Pigs only hit their own color—no target-picking hassle.
Conveyor capacity: Timing and queue management add a bite-size strategy layer.
5 waiting slots: Stack, sort, and launch at the perfect moment.
Short but “one more round” feel: Perfect for micro-breaks.
Satisfying pixel cleanup: Every hit leaves the board feeling crisp.
For anyone who loves fast action-puzzles, timing, and flow management. The pigs are ready. The cubes… not so much.

updates.desc:
Welcome to Colony Flow — a relaxing ant colony puzzle where every tiny ant has a job to do! Tap a box, watch the workers pour out, and send them marching up to the pixel picture to carry colorful blocks back to the nest, one busy trip at a time.

Each level gives you a stack of ant boxes and just five open slots. Tap a box and it slides into a slot, releasing a swarm of ants in that color — they'll haul away every matching block in the picture. Clear a box and the slot frees up for the next one.

That's where the thinking starts. Open a color that has nothing left to carry and that slot stays clogged. Fill all five and your colony grinds to a halt. Read the picture, count what's left, and choose your boxes in the right order to keep the ants flowing.

COMMAND YOUR COLONY

- Tap a box to send its ants marching
- Watch workers haul matching blocks back to the nest
- Manage your five slots — don't let them clog
- Unlock the boxes buried further down the stack
- Clear every block to finish the puzzle

EASY TO LEARN, SATISFYING TO SOLVE

- One-tap controls — start playing in seconds
- Puzzles that grow from cozy to genuinely clever
- No timers, no lives, no pressure — take as long as you like
- Watch trails of ants stream across the board as your plan pays off
- Every solved board reveals the picture hiding underneath

DISCOVER PIXEL ART
Complete hundreds of colorful levels with themes like animals, fruit, food, flowers, nature, festivals, toys, rockets, castles, and plenty more s

Yarn Loop is a relaxing and satisfying puzzle game featuring colorful yarn bobbins and knitted patterns.

Bobbins move onto the conveyor and collect stitches of their own color. Each bobbin has a capacity value that decreases as stitches are picked up. When its capacity reaches zero, the bobbin disappears. If capacity remains, the bobbin is transferred to the rack and can be used again later.
 
Complete each knitted pattern by using the right bobbins in the right order.

Game Features
► Simple One-Tap Gameplay: Bobbins move smoothly through the conveyor system and collect matching stitches with ease.
► Color-Based Collection Mechanic: Each bobbin clears only the stitches of its own color.
► Capacity Management System: Every bobbin has a limited pickup value, creating thoughtful and satisfying puzzle decisions.
► Rack Reuse Function: Bobbins that still have capacity return to the rack and remain available for later use.
► Hundreds of Engaging Levels: New knitted layouts, color combinations, and puzzle arrangements appear throughout progression.
► Cozy Yarn Aesthetic: Soft textures, warm colors, and pleasant animations create a calm and enjoyable experience.

Yarn Loop offers a smooth, calm, and visually charming journey through handcrafted yarn puzzles.

The room shares one clock, and every phone times its own press on it. The first to buzz answers; everyone else sees how far behind they were, to the hundredth of a second. TEAMS

Up to four teams. Players pick a side, or captains draft them on a thirty-second clock.

A BUZZER THAT IS YOURS

NO INTERNET NEEDED

The phones talk to each other directly. Leave Wi-Fi switched on; you don't need a network or signal. The app sends us something only if you use referrals: scanning or typing in a friend's code sends their code, yours, and the app's version and build number; checking how many people your code has brought sends your code. all.desc:
Three word puzzles, and a garden that grows as you solve them.

THE GARDEN
Every pack is ten puzzles, and every two packs grow a plant: finish the first and a sprout appears, finish the second and it grows in full. There are 27 plants in three groves of nine: tulip, fern, cactus, monstera, orchid, bonsai, lavender and more. Each plant shows its name, the date you earned it and the theme of the pack it came from, and plants you have not grown yet wait as silhouettes. They are earned by playing, never bought. A garden strip on the home screen leads to the full garden. Daily puzzles do not grow plants.

GROUPS
Sort words into groups that share a link. Some words fit more than one group, and that is the puzzle. Each board is 16 words in four groups, and you may make four mistakes.

SEARCH
A letter grid and no list of words. Trace a path through neighbouring letters, turning at any of them, diagonals included, and build words you thought of yourself. The only clue is how many words of each length are hiding. Reach par and the puzzle is solved: 10 words on a 4x4 grid, 14 on 5x5, 18 on 6x6. Words past par are a bonus. A wrong trace costs nothing.

GUESS
Find the hidden word, five, six or seven letters long. You get six tries, seven on the longest. Every letter is marked for whether it is in the word and whether it is in the right place, with a shape as well as a colour. Hard Mode, in Settings, makes every revealed letter compulsory in your next guess.

A PUZZLE EVERY DAY
Every mode

all.name: Boardroom Betrayal
all.desc:
One firm. A handful of moles. Find the MegaMole before they hollow it out. Boardroom Betrayal is an in-person social deduction game for 5 to 15 players. Everyone sits around one table with their own phone — the app deals the roles, runs the night and keeps the clock, so nobody has to sit out as the moderator.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Someone hosts a room; everyone else joins by scanning its QR code or typing the code.
• Each player is secretly dealt a role: a Loyal Employee with a special ability, a Contractor with a quirk that can backfire, or one of the Moles.
• At night everyone faces outward and their phone tells them, in secret, when it's their turn - the MegaMole chooses who to eliminate, protectors shield, info roles learn what they can.
• By day the table argues it out, nominates suspects, hears their defence and votes.
• The firm wins by voting out the MegaMole. The moles win if the firm is hollowed out first.

FEATURES
• 22 roles, from the Whistleblower and the Receptionist to the Gaslighter and the Nepo Hire
• No moderator needed — the app runs every phase and timer
• Private notes tab to track who claimed what
• Full rules and a role reference, readable before the game starts
• App and website can share the same room

No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

all.name: Vector Lane
all.desc:
Vector Lane is a real-time puzzle game about arrows that carry numbers. Every arrow has an X and a Y component, a length and an energy, and it travels along glowing lanes on its own. You never steer the arrow. Instead you prepare the machines before it arrives: cutters, mirrors, gates, pedals, sieves, merge rings, projection rails and compression chambers.

Four distinct modes teach four ways of thinking. Split Lane cuts a vector into its components, steers each part through its own lane and fuses them back inside an orbiting ring. Projection Rail turns rails in thirty degree steps and presses arrows onto them, storing what gets removed to open energy doors later. Compression Works parks two arrows in a chamber where a pinch adds them, a spread cancels them and a twist swaps or flips the result. Vector Pipeline links everything into one production line.

Many hand built lanes with their own layouts, a detailed How to Play guide, a mechanism codex, a run archive and a vector lab for experimenting without a timer. Earn three stars per lane for clean, efficient and well timed runs. Game is calm and designed for one hand.

all.desc:
Conveyor’s ready, pigs are on standby. Tap to send a pig onto the conveyor so it rains balls onto pixel cubes of its own color. The number above its head is its ammo: that’s how many hits it makes. Run out and it leaves the stage; if not, it slips into one of the 5 waiting slots and, when you tap again, it jumps back on the conveyor to fire another round.

One-tap control: Quick sessions, easy one-handed play.
Color matching: Pigs only hit their own color—no target-picking hassle.

5 waiting slots: Stack, sort, and launch at the perfect moment.
Short but “one more round” feel: Perfect for micro-breaks.
Satisfying pixel cleanup: Every hit leaves the board feeling crisp.
For anyone who loves fast action-puzzles, timing, and flow management. The pigs are ready. The cubes… not so much.

Tap a gem and watch its whole cluster glide home, one shining piece at a time, until a bright gem art picture is complete. No timers. No energy system. No fail screens. Just you, the gems, and a calm little puzzle you can always solve.

HOW TO PLAY

• Tap a gem, move a cluster. Every connected gem of the same color is picked up together, then flies to its matching space one by one.
• Read the board. Each space shows the color of the gem it is waiting for. Match gem to space and it locks in with a satisfying click.
• Use the tray. Two roomy rows hold the gems you are not ready to place yet, so sorting stays strategic, never frustrating.
• Reveal the picture. Place the last gem and watch the full pixel art scene light up, saved forever in your gallery.

WHY PLAYERS LOVE IT

• Genuinely relaxing. No countdowns, no energy system, no pressure. Play one puzzle on a coffee break or twenty in a row.
• Satisfying gem sorting. Move the colors around, organize the design, and watch order emerge one gem at a time.
• Always solvable. Every level has a solution, so getting stuck is temporary, never fatal.
• Gentle learning curve. The first puzzles teach themselves. Later boards are wide, layered and worth real thought.
• Handy helpers. Extra tray space, undo, hints, and a smart tap that tidies up the easy gems for you.

all.desc:
Every level is a pixel art masterpiece. Your ants will devour it - one color at a time.

Food Hunt is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the puzzle board IS the art. Each level presents a hand-crafted pixel art image built entirely from colored blocks. Sort your ants by color, send them in, and watch them eat the picture clean - block by block, until the board is empty and the level is cleared.

HOW TO PLAY
The board is filled with a pixel art image - built entirely from colored blocks. Below the board: your holding slots and block stacks waiting to be tapped.

Tap a block stack to load your ants. They march up and devour every matching colored block in the image. Clear all colors - wipe the board completely - and you win.

But choose your order carefully:

- Holding slots are limited - wrong tap order fills them fast
- Stuck slots = ants can't move = game over
- Plan which color to clear first
- Eat every last block - board empty - level clear!

THE PIXEL ART IS THE PUZZLE
Forget collecting rewards after you win. In Food Hunt, the pixel art image is the challenge itself.

Every level is a different image, built from hundreds of colored blocks. Watch your ants devour it layer by layer, color by color, until nothing remains.

You don't unlock the art. You clear it. And that's exactly what makes it satisfying.

FEATURES
-  200+ color sort puzzle levels -  new images, new challenges
-  Cute ants with ASMR-quality chomping animations
-  Simple one-tap controls - play with one h

Welcome to Colony Flow — a relaxing ant colony puzzle where every tiny ant has a job to do! Tap a box, watch the workers pour out, and send them marching up to the pixel picture to carry colorful blocks back to the nest, one busy trip at a time.

Each level gives you a stack of ant boxes and just five open slots. Tap a box and it slides into a slot, releasing a swarm of ants in that color — they'll haul away every matching block in the picture. Clear a box and the slot frees up for the next one.

That's where the thinking starts. Open a color that has nothing left to carry and that slot stays clogged. Fill all five and your colony grinds to a halt. Read the picture, count what's left, and choose your boxes in the right order to keep the ants flowing.

COMMAND YOUR COLONY

- Tap a box to send its ants marching
- Watch workers haul matching blocks back to the nest
- Manage your five slots — don't let them clog

- Clear every block to finish the puzzle

all.name: Yarn Loop: Knit Puzzle
all.desc:
Yarn Loop is a relaxing and satisfying puzzle game featuring colorful yarn bobbins and knitted patterns.

Bobbins move onto the conveyor and collect stitches of their own color. Each bobbin has a capacity value that decreases as stitches are picked up. When its capacity reaches zero, the bobbin disappears. If capacity remains, the bobbin is transferred to the rack and can be used again later.
 
Complete each knitted pattern by using the right bobbins in the right order.

Game Features
► Simple One-Tap Gameplay: Bobbins move smoothly through the conveyor system and collect matching stitches with ease.
► Color-Based Collection Mechanic: Each bobbin clears only the stitches of its own color.
► Capacity Management System: Every bobbin has a limited pickup value, creating thoughtful and satisfying puzzle decisions.
► Rack Reuse Function: Bobbins that still have capacity return to the rack and remain available for later use.
► Hundreds of Engaging Levels: New knitted layouts, color combinations, and puzzle arrangements appear throughout progression.
► Cozy Yarn Aesthetic: Soft textures, warm colors, and pleasant animations create a calm and enjoyable experience.

Yarn Loop offers a smooth, calm, and visually charming journey through handcrafted yarn puzzles.

Classic Match-3 Gameplay with Fresh Twists

- Discover unique game modes like Gummy Dragons and Bubblegum Pop.

Brain-Boosting Challenges & Special Events

- Tournaments & Leaderboards: Crush more candies than your friends and rise to the top to become the ultimate match-3 master!

Bonbon Blitz Your Way Through Extra Sticky Levels

- Use powerful boosters like Bonbon Blitz, Lollipop Hammer, and Jelly Fish to solve puzzles and boost your score.
- Stuck on a level? Boosters and extra moves will help you blast through any obstacle.

Play Offline or Online, Anytime and Anywhere

- No internet, no problem: Enjoy offline gameplay and keep the fun going wherever you are.
- Ad-free fun means uninterrupted candy-matching bliss!

Connect with Friends & Join the Candy Kingdom

In this brand-new sequel, you'll follow quirky plot lines and make clever use of clues and interactive elements to crack a series of bizarre yet cleverly constructed levels.

Each scene is packed with carefully designed puzzles, unconventional logic, and unexpected twists—making you think outside the box and enjoy a perfect mix of reasoning and creativity.

No complex systems needed—just tap, swipe, and explore! It's a fun and accessible brain challenge that anyone can enjoy. And if you get stuck, don’t worry—our trusty “Brain Buddy” will give you playful hints to spark new ideas and help you move forward.

Game Features:

Bigger, Weirder Stories – Absurd scenarios mixed with trending jokes and clever twists, sparking laughs and wild creativity!

Think Differently – These puzzles aren’t what they seem... flip your logic and find the unexpected solution.

Simple, Fun Controls – Tap, drag, and solve. No learning curve—just dive in and play.

Unlimited Hints – Stuck? Get as many helpful hints as you need.

Join us now and challenge the limits of your imagination! Use your creativity and wit to conquer this absurd and delightful puzzle adventure, and feel the thrill of every solution.


This is just the beginning! More levels and crazy stories are on the way—stay tuned!

Quick Play Guide

- Start Simple: Tap a bottle to pick it up, and another to pour the water. Organize the water so each bottle has only one color.
- Think Ahead: Pour water only if it matches the top color of the destination bottle and there’s room. Plan to avoid dead ends and strategically sort the colors.
- Embrace Complexity: With each level, sorting and matching require more thought. Every move is crucial.
- Utilize Magic Tools: Stuck? Use 'Undo' to reverse moves, or 'Shuffle' to rearrange the bottles anew, making sorting a breeze.

- Unique Twists: Classic puzzles get a magical makeover for extra thrill, blending color, water, and puzzle elements seamlessly.
- Boosts & Surprises: Stir up boosts in the cauldron to power through puzzles, adding a layer of strategy to your color sorting.
- Mystical Ingredients: Gather ingredients to brew stronger magic, enhancing your water sort adventures.
